Sweater knitting pattern.
Sizes: S M L.
Construction: top down raglan, knit in the round.
Yarn: Merino wool, 500 g.
Needles 4 mm.
Needles 4.5 mm for ribbing.
Gauge: 20 stitches and 28 rows = 10 cm.
Abbreviations:
k - knit
p - purl
Body
Cast on 80 stitches.
Row 1: knit all stitches.
Row 2: purl all stitches.
Repeat rows 1-2 twice.
Bind off 80 stitches.
